meta.title: Navaro – find the company, reach the decision maker, send the offer
meta.description: Navaro helps small B2B teams manage companies, contacts and relationships, find decision makers, prepare personalized outreach, and create professional quotes — in one workspace. Currently in beta.

hero.badge: NAVARO Beta is ready for testing
hero.subtext: Navaro brings Company Record, contacts and relationships, decision-maker discovery, personalized outreach drafts and OfferGen into one workspace. You work from current context and stay in control — nothing is sent automatically.

solutions.title: What is ready today in NAVARO Beta.
solutions.subtitle: One connected workspace for the B2B flow — find the company, reach the right decision maker, prepare the outreach and create the offer. Currently in beta.

items.name: Company & Relationship Hub
items.description: Company Record, contacts and relationships in one place — a single view of a customer, its people and the relevant business context.

items.name: Discovery & Decision Makers
items.description: Run a bounded search for a company's likely decision makers, review the evidence and confidence, then accept the right ones as contacts or dismiss the rest. Result quality can vary by company and public sources.

items.name: AI Company Context & Outreach
items.description: Describe your company once — or fill it from your official website — and prepare a personalized, editable outreach draft for a chosen contact in EN, SK, PL or IT. You review and send it yourself; nothing is sent automatically.

items.name: OfferGen
items.description: Create and edit quotes, export a PDF, share a public offer link, and track approve / reject status — with company context attached.

items.name: Team & audit
items.description: Invite your team with workspace roles and membership controls, and keep an audit trail of the actions that matter.

items.name: Company enrichment & directory
items.description: On-demand company-data enrichment and a searchable company directory with filters are on the roadmap — not available yet.

about.label: About us
about.title: Navaro is built from real sales workflows.
about.body1: The product is not a generic CRM. We focus on the moments where companies lose time: outdated data, scattered contacts, unclear relationships and manual quote preparation.
about.body2: That is why we connect the application, admin operations and Business Circle discovery. We validate needs with companies first, then turn them into simple working tools.

why.label: Why Navaro
why.title: One workflow instead of isolated spreadsheets and documents.

items.title: Faster quote preparation
items.text: OfferGen reduces repeated administration around creating, exporting and sending business quotes.

items.title: Data stays with companies and contacts
items.text: Company Record, contacts and relationships keep sales context together instead of scattered notes.

items.title: Audit and controlled workflow
items.text: Workspace membership lifecycle, UI and audit are ready for more controlled beta team operations.

items.title: Discovery drives the roadmap
items.text: Discovery Review, the DMF foundation and Business Circle help validate what has real value for companies.
